name: Devil Is Real
overview: Scripture reveals the reality of the devil as a personal, malevolent being who is the originator of lies and destruction, opposed to the truth and life that Christ offers. Jesus identifies the devil as a murderer and the father of lies, intent on stealing, killing, and destroying, while He Himself came to give abundant life. Believers are called to submit to God and actively resist the devil, who will flee from them, assured by the promise that God will ultimately crush Satan under their feet. This underscores the spiritual battle believers face, grounded in God's sovereign power and righteous judgment.
